howItWorks.title: From sign-up to applying in four steps
howItWorks.description: No searching through dozens of portals. Here is exactly what happens after you join.

account.title: Create a free account
account.body: Sign up with your email and a password, then confirm your email from the link we send you.

profile.title: Fill your profile once
profile.body: Five short steps: education, marks and attendance, family and income, category and background, documents you have. Save and come back any time.

matches.title: See your matches
matches.body: Every scheme is sorted into Eligible, Almost eligible or Not eligible, with a plain-language reason for each.

apply.title: Apply on the official site
apply.body: Open a scheme to see its documents, steps and deadline, then use the official link. Track it in Fundora and get reminders.

results.title: Three clear answers, never a guess
results.description: Every result tells you why, so you know what to do next.

eligible.title: Eligible
eligible.body: You meet every rule. Check the documents and apply before the deadline.
eligible.example: “Your marks and income meet every rule.”

almost.title: Almost eligible
almost.body: You are close on one or two things like income, marks or attendance. We show how close, so you can check with the scheme or your college.

not.title: Not eligible
not.body: A key rule does not match, such as course, state or category. You still see why, so you do not waste time.
not.example: “This scheme is only for law students.”

features.title: Everything you need to find and keep funding
features.description: Built for students who are short on time and tired of missing deadlines.

oneProfile.title: One profile, every scheme
oneProfile.body: Answer once. We check you against every scheme in our database, and re-check when you update.

reasons.title: Plain-language reasons
reasons.body: No jargon. Each result says exactly which rule you meet or miss, in rupees and percentages.

details.title: Clear scheme pages
details.body: Amount, deadline, documents needed, step-by-step instructions and the official link, all on one page.

tracker.title: Application tracker
tracker.body: Move each scheme through Saved, Applying, Applied, Awarded and Renewal due, so nothing slips.

reminders.title: Deadline reminders
reminders.body: Email reminders 14, 7 and 1 day before a saved deadline, plus renewal reminders every year.

verified.title: Verified sources
verified.body: Every scheme shows its official source and the date we last checked it. Old data is flagged.

guides.title: Step-by-step guides
guides.body: Simple guides for National Scholarship Portal sign-up, Aadhaar–bank seeding and getting certificates.

counsellor.title: Help from your counsellor
counsellor.body: Link with your college counsellor or an NGO for guidance. They see your matches only if you accept.

language.title: Works on any phone
language.body: Light and fast on slow networks. English today, with Kannada and Hindi on the way.

coverage.title: More than scholarships
coverage.description: Fundora lists every kind of support an undergraduate can get, from central and state governments and private foundations.
coverage.coursesBody: Engineering, medicine, nursing, pharmacy, arts, science, commerce, law, management, design, agriculture and more.
coverage.rolloutBody: We start with central government and Karnataka schemes, then add other states as each one is verified.

prepare.title: Keep these handy
prepare.description: You don't upload anything to Fundora. We only ask whether you have each document, so we can tell you what's missing for a scheme.

documents.marks: Latest marks cards or grade sheets
documents.caste: Caste or category certificate, if it applies to you
documents.disability: Disability certificate, if it applies to you
documents.bonafide: College bonafide certificate and fee receipt
documents.bank: A bank account seeded with your Aadhaar

tips.email: Use an email you check often. Reminders go there.
tips.exact: Enter income and marks exactly as on your certificates.
tips.update: Update your profile every year. Renewals depend on attendance and CGPA.
tips.confirm: Always read the rules on the official site before you submit.

safety.title: Your data stays yours
safety.description: Scholarship scams are common. Here is exactly what Fundora will and will not do.

never.fee: Charge you a fee of any kind
never.password: Ask for portal passwords or OTPs
never.ids: Ask for your Aadhaar or bank account number
never.submit: Fill or submit application forms for you

promise.encrypt: Income, category and disability details are encrypted
promise.consent: Counsellors see your profile only after you accept
promise.delete: Delete your account and all your data at any time
promise.official: Every apply button goes to the official website

safety.warningBody: If anyone using the Fundora name asks you for money, an OTP or a password, it is a scam. Do not pay, and report it to us.

free.a: Yes. Fundora is free for students and always will be. There is no premium plan and no fee to see your matches.

apply.a: No. Fundora finds schemes and explains them. You apply yourself on the scheme's official website, using the link on each scheme page.

accuracy.a: Results come from the rules in each scheme's official notice, and every scheme shows when we last checked it. Rules can change, so always confirm on the official site before you submit.

data.q: What information do I need to share?
data.a: Your course, marks, attendance, family income, category, state and a few yes/no questions. Sensitive details are encrypted. We never ask for Aadhaar, bank or ID numbers.

almost.q: What should I do if I'm “Almost eligible”?
almost.a: Read the reason. If it is a small gap, like attendance or marks, check the latest official rules or ask your college. Some schemes allow exceptions or update limits each year.

who.a: Any undergraduate student in India, across 19 course categories. We cover central and Karnataka schemes first and add more states over time.

wrong.q: I found wrong information. What do I do?
wrong.a: Use the “Report wrong info” button on the scheme page. Our team checks every report against the official source.

language.q: Is Fundora available in my language?
language.a: Fundora is in English today. Kannada and Hindi are coming next.
